payload.name: Scent-Based Navigation
payload.fact: The SNIF-ACT 2.0 model, which utilizes information scent and a Bayesian satisficing model, provided better fits to human navigation data than the SNIF-ACT 1.0 model and a position-based model.

provenance.title: SNIF-ACT: A Cognitive Model of User Navigation on the World Wide Web
provenance.quote_or_locus: Monte Carlo simulations of the model showed that SNIF-ACT 2.0 provided better fits to human data than SNIF-ACT 1.0 and a Position model that used position of links on a Web page to decide which link to select
